summary.text: Kathleen Taylor is a Democratic member of the Oregon State Senate for District 21, which her legislative page lists as Milwaukie, Oak Grove and parts of southeast and northeast Portland.
Her biography says she was elected to the Oregon House in 2015 and has served in the Senate since 2017.

paragraphs.text: Taylor has lived in Oregon for more than 25 years and lives in southeast Portland with her husband and two children, according to her biography.
She began her career as a recruiter for Boly:Welch, then earned a graduate degree in public policy at Rutgers University and worked as a management auditor.
Her work for the City of Portland, Metro, Multnomah County and the Oregon Secretary of State's Office, the page says, focused on making government more efficient and transparent.
She holds a bachelor's degree in political science and psychology from the University of Wisconsin-Madison and a master's degree in public policy from Rutgers University.
Her volunteer work includes serving as a Court Appointed Special Advocate, serving as a VISTA volunteer in rural Idaho, and serving on the Portland Public Schools Citizen Budget Review Committee.
